name: The weak Schur numbers for 3-coloring.
comment: a(6) >= 1146 and a(7) >= 2005 (see Ahmed et al., Table 6).
a(k) = WS_k(3), the least N such that every 3-coloring of [1,N] has distinct same-colored x_1,...,x_k whose sum has the same color.
a(5) = 593: the coloring of [1,592] in Ahmed et al. gives the lower bound, and an exhaustive SAT computation modulo permutations of the three colors gives the upper bound. (End)
link: T. Ahmed, L. Boza, M. P. Revuelta, and M. I. Sanz, Exact values and lower bounds on the n-color weak Schur numbers for n=2,3. Ramanujan J (2023). See Table 6 at p. 8 and Sections 4.3 and 4.4 at pp. 13-16.
Alper Ferudun, Self-contained C++20 program for a(5)
